column12: I raised my eyes, to You O Lord, like the eyes of, the servant to his Master.

column12: Loosen from me, the bonds of sin, help me through, Your love for mankind.

column12: + That I may begin, with great desire, of all my power, to offer You glory.

column12: Who were spoken about, by the psalmist, David the divine-mantled, in his psalm.

column12: Truly they are planted, by the rivers of water, because of their pure hearts, until they completed their days.

column12: + The explanation of your name, is in the mouth of the faithful, it also became, a support for us.

column12: You are exalted more, than the patriarchs, and honored more, than the prophets.

column12: You are a prophet, you are an apostle, you are an anchorite, you are a martyr.

column12: + Christ your King, said to the multitude, "You are greater, than a prophet."

column12: The mouth of Zacharias, witnessed to us, when his tongue spoke, after he wrote your name.

column12: + To lift up the pains, from His people, and look down from above, with the eye of His goodness.

column12: + Because of Your mercy, do not forsake us, O God of our salvation, but accept us to You.

column12: Disperse from us the evil, of the heretics, through the intercessions, of the Baptist.

column12: Hail to John, son of Zacharias, hail to the kinsman, of the Messiah.
